mapper.select: SELECT w.user_id, u.display_name, w.date AS sample_date, u.goal, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'PLANNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS planned_sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_sessions, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN w.actual_calories ELSE 0 END), 0) AS actual_calories FROM workouts w INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = w.user_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id FROM workouts WHERE date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minimumEvents} ) eligible ON eligible.user_id = w.user_id WHERE w.date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY w.user_id, w.date, u.goal, u.display_name ORDER BY w.user_id, w.date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comparison_daily_samples (participant_key, masked_display_name, sample_date, goal, completed_sessions, planned_sessions, cancelled_sessions, actual_calories, source, dataset_version) VALUES (#{participantKey}, #{maskedDisplayName}, #{sampleDate}, #{goal}, #{completedSessions}, #{plannedSessions}, #{cancelledSessions}, #{actualCalories}, #{source}, #{datasetVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE masked_display_name = VALUES(masked_display_name), goal = VALUES(goal), completed_sessions = VALUES(completed_sessions), planned_sessions = VALUES(planned_sessions), cancelled_sessions = VALUES(cancelled_sessions), actual_calories = VALUES(actual_calories), source = VALUES(source)
